name: Top Glove Corporation Bhd.
overview: 2026年，Top Glove 的公告主要涉及股份拆细/附加上市、季度业绩、董事委员会成员变动及公司秘书变更，未披露手套制造、橡胶相关产品、包装材料、医疗保健产品、工程机械或医疗器械分销等业务板块的产能扩张、新业务、缩减、出售或合约签订事项。最新季度营收同比增长39.7%，净利润同比增长352.6%。
overview_en: In 2026, Top Glove's announcements mainly covered share subdivision/additional listing, quarterly results, changes in board committee members and company secretary; no capacity expansion, new business, reduction, disposal or contract signing was disclosed for the glove manufacturing, rubber-related products, packaging materials, medical and healthcare products, engineering and machinery, or medical device distribution segments.
